messages:
ravi_cs: quick draft for impacted customers. goal: short, clear, and include RCA, mitigation, timeline, credit offer, and an RSVP for office hours. please review.

emma_eng: RCA: a queue-shard routing change at ~03:05 UTC unintentionally rate-limited part of the onboarding worker pool. rollback at 03:28 UTC, backfill started. throughput ~80% now; expect catch-up in ~5-7 hours depending on spikes. incident INC-2026-59812.

linda_se: add that we temporarily increased backfill capacity by 3x and applied a patch to the shard logic. confirm no data loss.

ravi_cs: draft outbound (please edit):

ravi_cs: ```Hi <Customer>,
Were sorry for the disruption. Earlier today (approx 03:0003:30 UTC) a configuration change affected our onboarding ingestion pipeline, delaying processing of some uploads and trial imports. We reverted the change and started a backfill; processing is underway and we expect full catch-up within 57 hours.

Root cause: queue-shard routing mismatch caused throttling of part of the worker pool (INC-2026-59812).
What we did: rolled back the change, temporarily increased backfill capacity by 3x, patched shard routing, and are monitoring until caught-up.
Impact: no data loss; search/embedding completeness will return once backfill completes.
Next steps: were hosting office hours today at 15:00 UTC (RSVP link). Were offering a one-time onboarding credit up to $200 for affected onboarding windows. If youre in a renewal window or need prioritized help, reply and well schedule a 30-minute review with Solutions Engineering and your AE.
Thanks for your patience.
Ravi, Customer Success```

chris_ae: I'll flag renewal customers and join any escalations. please include an RSVP + calendar invite and a one-question feedback checkbox about renewal impact.

ops_bot: INC-2026-59812 status: RESOLVED (rollback + backfill). public status: https://redwood.status/incidents/INC-2026-59812 :white_check_mark:

linda_se: legal ok on "one-time onboarding credit up to $200" but add clause "credits applied at company discretion" and link to T&Cs.

ravi_cs: checklist before send: 1) add T&C link 2) RSVP + calendar invites 3) renewal flags appended 4) AE/SEP ping. target send at 09:30 UTC. will post final copy here for a last sign-off. :thumbsup:
